cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.subtitle: Cookie Policy
cookies.section1.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
cookies.section1.content: Cookies are small text files stored on the user's device while browsing a website. Cookies allow the website to recognize the user's device and customize the content to their preferences.
cookies.section2.title: 2. What Cookies Do We Use?
cookies.section2.intro: Our website uses the following types of cookies:
cookies.section2.essential.title: Essential Cookies
cookies.section2.essential.content: Provide basic website functions such as security, network management, and accessibility. They cannot be disabled as the website will not function properly without them.
cookies.section2.functional.title: Functional Cookies
cookies.section2.functional.content: Allow the website to remember user choices (e.g., preferred language, font size) to provide a more personalized experience.
cookies.section2.analytics.title: Analytics Cookies
cookies.section2.analytics.content: Help understand how users interact with the website by collecting and reporting information anonymously. This enables improvement of the website's functionality.
cookies.section2.marketing.title: Marketing Cookies
cookies.section2.marketing.content: Used to track users across websites to display advertisements that are relevant and interesting to individual users. (Currently not in use)
cookies.section3.title: 3. Third-Party Cookies
cookies.section3.intro: Our website may use cookies from third-party service providers, such as:
cookies.section3.item1.label: Google Analytics
cookies.section3.item2.label: Google Fonts
cookies.section3.footer: These providers may use cookies in accordance with their own privacy policies.
cookies.section4.title: 4. Managing Cookies
cookies.section4.intro: Users can control and manage cookies in various ways:
cookies.section4.browser.title: Browser Settings
cookies.section4.browser.intro: Most browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can change these settings:
cookies.section4.browser.chrome: Chrome: Settings > Privacy and security > Cookies
cookies.section4.delete.title: Deleting Cookies
cookies.section4.delete.content: You can delete cookies stored on your device at any time through your browser settings. Please note, however, that deleting cookies may affect the functionality of the website.
cookies.section5.title: 5. Consent to Cookies
cookies.section5.content: By continuing to browse our website without changing your browser settings, you consent to the use of cookies in accordance with this policy.
cookies.section6.title: 6. Policy Updates
cookies.section6.content: We may periodically update this Cookie Policy. Any changes will be published on this page with an updated "Last updated" date.
